events.title: Invention of the Wheel
events.description: The earliest known wheels were used for pottery in Mesopotamia.

events.title: Invention of Papyrus
events.description: The ancient Egyptians developed papyrus for writing.

events.title: Invention of the Abacus
events.description: The earliest counting tool used in Sumeria.

events.title: Invention of Glass
events.description: The first glass objects were created in Mesopotamia and Egypt.

events.title: Invention of the Compass
events.description: The magnetic compass was first invented in China during the Han Dynasty.

events.title: Invention of Paper
events.description: Cai Lun is credited with the invention of modern paper in China.

events.title: Invention of the Windmill
events.description: The first windmills were used in Persia for irrigation and grinding grain.

events.title: Invention of Gunpowder
events.description: Gunpowder was discovered by Chinese alchemists looking for an elixir of life.

events.title: Invention of Movable Type
events.description: Bi Sheng invented the first movable type printing system in China.

events.title: Invention of the Mechanical Clock
events.description: The first weight-driven mechanical clocks appeared in Europe.

events.title: Invention of Eyeglasses
events.description: The first wearable eyeglasses were developed in Italy.

events.title: Gutenberg's Printing Press
events.description: Johannes Gutenberg invented the metal movable type printing press.

events.title: Invention of the Microscope
events.description: Janssen and his son created the first compound microscope.

events.title: Invention of the Telescope
events.description: Hans Lippershey applied for the first patent for a telescope.

events.title: Invention of the Barometer
events.description: Evangelista Torricelli invented the mercury barometer.

events.title: Invention of the Reflecting Telescope
events.description: Isaac Newton built the first functional reflecting telescope.

events.title: Invention of the Steam Engine
events.description: Thomas Newcomen built the first practical atmospheric steam engine.

events.title: Invention of the Lightning Rod
events.description: Benjamin Franklin demonstrated that lightning is electricity.

events.title: Invention of the Spinning Jenny
events.description: James Hargreaves invented the multi-spindle spinning frame.

events.title: Invention of the Steam Locomotive
events.description: Richard Trevithick built the first full-scale working steam locomotive.

events.title: Invention of the Battery
events.description: Alessandro Volta created the first chemical battery, the voltaic pile.

events.title: Invention of the Stethoscope
events.description: René Laennec invented the first acoustic stethoscope.

events.title: Invention of Photography
events.description: Nicéphore Niépce took the first permanent photograph.

events.title: Invention of the Electric Telegraph
events.description: Samuel Morse and others developed the telegraph system.

events.title: Invention of the Morse Code
events.description: A method for transmitting text information as a series of on-off pulses.

events.title: Invention of the Rubber Vulcanization
events.description: Charles Goodyear discovered the process to make rubber more durable.

events.title: Invention of the Sewing Machine
events.description: Elias Howe patented the first practical lockstitch sewing machine.

events.title: Invention of the Elevator Safety Brake
events.description: Elisha Otis invented the mechanism that prevents elevators from falling.

events.title: Invention of the Bessemer Process
events.description: The first inexpensive industrial process for the mass production of steel.

events.title: Invention of the Internal Combustion Engine
events.description: Jean Joseph Etienne Lenoir built the first successful gas engine.

events.title: Invention of Dynamite
events.description: Alfred Nobel invented a safer way to use nitroglycerin.

events.title: Invention of the Telephone
events.description: Alexander Graham Bell was granted the first patent for the telephone.

events.title: Invention of the Phonograph
events.description: Thomas Edison invented the device for recording and reproducing sound.

events.title: Invention of the Light Bulb
events.description: Thomas Edison developed a practical and long-lasting electric light bulb.

events.title: Invention of the Steam Turbine
events.description: Charles Parsons invented the modern steam turbine.

events.title: Invention of the Automobile
events.description: Karl Benz patented the first petrol-powered motor car.

events.title: Invention of the Radio
events.description: Guglielmo Marconi developed the first practical radio wave communication system.

events.title: Invention of the Airplane
events.description: The Wright brothers made the first controlled, powered airplane flight.

events.title: Invention of the Vacuum Tube
events.description: John Ambrose Fleming invented the first thermionic valve.

events.title: Invention of the Television
events.description: Philo Farnsworth demonstrated the first electronic television system.

events.title: Invention of Jet Engine
events.description: Frank Whittle and Hans von Ohain independently developed the jet engine.

events.title: Invention of the Computer (ENIAC)
events.description: The first general-purpose electronic digital computer.

events.title: Invention of the Transistor
events.description: Bardeen, Brattain, and Shockley invented the semiconductor device.

events.title: Invention of the Microwave Oven
events.description: Percy Spencer accidentally discovered microwave cooking.

events.title: Invention of the Laser
events.description: Theodore Maiman operated the first functional laser.

events.title: Invention of the Integrated Circuit
events.description: Jack Kilby and Robert Noyce independently developed the microchip.

events.title: Invention of the Arpanet (Internet)
events.description: The precursor to the modern Internet was established.

events.title: Invention of the Mobile Phone
events.description: Martin Cooper made the first handheld mobile phone call.

events.title: Invention of the Personal Computer
events.description: The Altair 8800 was released, sparking the PC revolution.

events.title: Invention of the GPS
events.description: The first satellite for the Global Positioning System was launched.
